tasks.title: Analysis report file unavailable
tasks.description: The referenced analysis report `rapport.txt` is not present in the repository, so issue extraction must use available validation signals.
tasks.errorContext: `view` and `glob` checks found no `rapport.txt` under the repository.
tasks.resolutionNotes: Searched repository paths for `rapport.txt`/`*rapport*.txt`; no file exists. Proceeded with baseline validation and CI log inspection to derive actionable tasks.

tasks.title: TypeScript config uses unsupported ignoreDeprecations value
tasks.description: Type-check fails because `tsconfig.json` sets `ignoreDeprecations` to `6.0`, which is invalid for the installed TypeScript version.
tasks.errorContext: `npx tsc --noEmit` => TS5103 Invalid value for '--ignoreDeprecations' at tsconfig.json:5.
tasks.resolutionNotes: Updated `ignoreDeprecations` from `6.0` to `5.0` in `tsconfig.json`. Re-ran `npx tsc --noEmit` and confirmed the TS5103 configuration error is resolved.

tasks.title: Investigate referenced CI/build failure context
